about_item: Immersive Audio with 13mm Drivers : Enjoy deep bass and crystal-clear sound with powerful 13mm drivers, delivering high-quality audio for music, calls, and entertainment on the go.
Long Battery Life & Fast Charging : Get up to 40 hours of playtime with the case. Just a 10-minute quick charge with Type C charger gives 100 minutes of use, keeping you powered throughout the day.
IPX5 Water & Sweat Resistant Design : Designed for workouts and outdoor use, these matte finished earbuds are IPX5 rated to resist sweat and splashes, keeping up with your active lifestyle.
Built-in Mic & Voice Assistant Ready : Take calls and control your device easily with a built-in microphone, voice assistant support, and intuitive touch controls for seamless use.
Mono Mode & Smart LED Indicators : Use either earbud solo in mono mode. LED indicators show battery status and pairing. Auto power off and low battery alerts ensure smart energy saving.

authors_reviews.title: Okay for basic listening, but terrible for calls and feels cheap
authors_reviews.text: I bought these Philips earbuds hoping for a solid everyday pair, but they fell short in a few major areas. Here is my honest breakdown of the product:Strictly for Basic Use: If you just want to listen to a podcast or some music while sitting in a quiet room, these will get the job done. They function fine as basic listening devices.Poor Microphone / Call Quality: Do not buy these if you plan on taking phone calls outside. Whenever I try to talk in a public place, the microphone struggles terribly. The person on the other end can never hear me properly, as it seems to pick up all the background noise instead of my voice.Cheap Build Quality: The plastic quality is distinctly below average. Both the charging case and the earbuds themselves feel quite flimsy and lack the premium feel you might expect from a brand like Philips.If you only need a backup pair for solitary, quiet listening, they might work for you. However, if you rely on your earbuds to take calls on the go, I highly recommend looking elsewhere.
